summary: North American Construction Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing its management discussion and analysis and interim financial statements for the three months ended March 31, 2026, along with earnings announcement. This is a routine quarterly report by a foreign private issuer. The filing discusses operational performance, the integration of Iron Mine Contracting, and project progress but does not announce any merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change. The filing is a routine current report on financial results.
